West Side Story: Is the buzz around a merger between the Ajit Pawar and Sharad Pawar factions of the NCP more than just political speculation? And who stands to gain from keeping the merger conversation alive? What is behind the merger buzz, and what does delimitation mean for India's political future? Girish Kuber breaks it down.
Producer: Tista Roy Chowdhury
Editor: Meetesh Dixit
Camera: Pradeep Pawar
The Indian Express brings you comprehensive coverage of global & indian politics, election news, business news, world affairs, sports, entertainment, Bollywood, and public policy.
